inputs.text: Open your eyes, people. They are pushing this graduation ceremony in Jaipur as a spontaneous outburst, but it is all a carefully scripted distraction to manage public perception and hide the real agenda of the elites pulling the strings. A student publicly protests right in front of the Deputy Chief Minister, and miraculously it goes viral to distract the masses while the higher-ups negotiate whatever they are really hiding behind closed doors. The official narrative claims mixed reactions and student rights, but that is just a smoke screen. Notice how the university administration is remaining silent? That is textbook coordination—they are lying low while the script plays out. This isn't about educational challenges at all; it's a manufactured spectacle.
